shortDescription: Relaxed building, farming, exploration, old roads, and waystone restoration for the ECHO platform.

positioning.coreFantasy: Build a homestead, follow old roads, restore waystones, and uncover quiet regions without hardcore upkeep pressure.
positioning.notACloneRule: Do not use Minecraft branding, names, copied recipes as identity, copied textures, copied mob silhouettes, or borrowed audio.

mvpAcceptance: Player can spawn in a safe start area.
Player can gather wood, stone, fiber, and food without combat.
Player can craft first tools, echoworldstarter:campfire, echostationcore:field_bench, shelter pieces, and echoworldstarter:bedroll.
Player can sleep in a forgiving shelter and set a return point.
Player can discover at least one road/ruin/cave hook.
Player can progress a broken waystone through at least stone_repaired.
Player inventory, hotbar, placed blocks, echostationcore:field_crate contents, echoworldstarter:bedroll spawn, echoworldstarter:campfire state, shelter score, and waystone state survive save/load.
